title: Before My Dad Died by Suicide, He Recorded 694 Videos to Help Me Understand Why
summary: A 35-foot fall didn’t kill Michael Wagner. The nearly 18-year failure of the safety net did. Before he died, he recorded 694 videos explaining how.
